studies.title: The Turin papyrus map
studies.caption: The scribe Amennakhte draws the Wadi Hammamat for an expedition to its quarries, with roads, hills coloured by rock and the gold mines marked.
studies.prompt: Overhead close study of an ancient Egyptian scribe painting a long papyrus strip around1160BCE, red-brown and dark hills, narrow winding wadi routes and quarry marks; reed brush and simple pigment dishes beside it. A sketch of cartographic practice, not a facsimile; no modern map grid or modern labels.
